title: Emmy Noether: Modern LaTeX Drafts and English Translation Working Drafts
version: 2026-05-29 Noether author record with Paper 02 high-fidelity continuation through page 60
description:
Author record for Emmy Noether in the Modern LaTeX Editions of Public-Domain Mathematics Manuscripts project. This page keeps Noether material together by author: original-language modern LaTeX reader PDFs, English translation drafts, high-fidelity paper-level restart material, and source/artifact files.

Status at a glance.

  • Original-language modern LaTeX reader: [######----] selected mathematical-papers draft remains front-facing.
  • Older cumulative English working reader: [#####-----] retained for breadth while paper-level replacements continue.
  • Paper-level high-fidelity restart: [##--------] Paper 01 has paired German/English readers; Paper 02 is now available through printed page 60, section 10, with paired German editable and English high-fidelity readers.
  • Source/artifact preservation: [##########] available TeX, component PDFs, source-scan references, figure slices, compile reports, and provenance are in 80 Noether - TeX Sources, Component PDFs, and Provenance.zip.
  • Proofreading/final edition status: [----------] working editions for checking, not certified critical editions.

The organization is by author and paper. Readers can use the older cumulative English draft for breadth while the paper-level restart incrementally replaces it with source-checkable original/translation pairs.
notes: Public author record. The older cumulative English reader remains available as a broad working draft; the paper-level high-fidelity stream now includes Paper 01 and Paper 02 through printed page 60, with source references and TeX in the artifact ZIP.
